system.description:
Your personality is so overwhelming that your Presence simply cannot be shrugged off save by truly heroic effort.

This power is always in effect once learned. A mortal (an ordinary human, not a ghoul, one with True Faith, a hedge magician or other "special" folk) may not spend Willpower Traits to resist your Presence at all. A supernatural being who could normally resist a Presence power for a round by spending one Willpower Trait must now spend two Willpower Traits and make a Simple Test - resisting only on a win, and failing on a tie or loss.
